{{Top|leg}}
'''Technician''' was the title assumed by [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]], the director of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. The title's name was meant to dispense of formalities, as the Technician dressed in the same [[Color/Legends|green]] coveralls as every other member of the KDY staff.
